eventGroups.description: Vytorin group- The eligible patients were allocated to one of vytorin 10/20 or atorvastatin 10 mg group in 1:1 ratio. If patients didn't achieve LDL-C \< 100 mg/dl after 6 weeks of treatment, they received the double dosage of study drug for the next 6 weeks (vytorin 10/40 or atorvastatin 20 mg) and If patients achieved LDL-C \< 100 mg/dl, they received the same dosage of study drug for the next 6 weeks. Patients who were allocated to vytorin had vytorin 10/20 mg or 10/40 mg tablet, orally, once a day.
